protocol.scope: Posthoc behavioral frequency-law evaluation. No production edits or artificial noise.
protocol.origin: Parent proposed law from nominal5.5MHz documentation and previously viewed producerC/Eb/G/Bb values; not independently preregistered or recovered silicon arithmetic.

producer.include: All63 rows; aggregate all62 source-qualified rows; preserve excluded row and both estimators.
producer.common_offset: One log-frequency scalar per pack, median of per-note means of FFT and phase cents errors; same scalar applies both estimators. Fit separately for candidate and equal-tempered comparator.
producer.qualification: Use pre-existing interval_fixture_accepted only; no new outlier exclusion.
producer.scores: Every row residual and bypack/estimator pooled meanabs,RMS,medianabs,maxabs; three packs may share physical instrument/capture.

pss780.include: All19 original windows, every existing estimator/source/channel, preserving invalid outputs; primary descriptive comparison is opus_float/mid/phase12.
pss780.common_offset: One scalar per model, mean cents error on the two original long G67 opus_float/mid/phase12 anchor rows from primary_pair_events. Apply unchanged to all19 windows, estimators, channels and encodes.
pss780.scores: All and noncalibration original19 opus_float/mid/phase12; retain every other method and capture with existing validity flags; no residual-based rejection.

protocol.interpretation: No fresh holdout claim: four producerclasses generated the law, their octave behavior was already viewed, old780results were previously reported. D/Ab are unfitted cross-class tests on reused data. No numeric wordwidth, divider, samplerate, phasebit or clock ppm identification.
protocol.parameter_changes_after_freeze: None permitted; rejection or uncertainty retained. Other-law search requires another protocol.

limitations: Posthoc hypothesis, not recovered OPU arithmetic; four producer pitch classes were used to derive the law.
Same-class octave observations were already seen; old780 data also previously analyzed. No fresh holdout claim.
All producer packs may share instrument and capture chain. Global nuisance includes source tuning/interface clock/SRC; not measured master-clock offset.
Short old780 windows retain mixture/effects/codec/history and estimator biases. All original measurements and flags preserved.
Nominal5.5MHz alone does not establish six-clock processing, a24-bit accumulator, internalrate or phaseword register.
MIDI36..96 is documented c.00 receive range; sampled classes coverC/Eb/G/Bb, while all12table values and outside-range behavior remain extrapolations.
Operator multiplier, fine/coarse detune, pitchbend and clock interaction order are not identified by stationary roots. No noise added.
title: Frozen OPU behavioral frequency-law hypothesis, 2026-10-19

decision.integration_recommendation: Explicit selectable candidate; preserve equal-tempered compatibility and unverified range/operator-order limits.
